note: chapter_title is "SUMMARY" rather than a chapter name, and the heading list starts at 14.1.1, so the 14.1 overview heading is absent; the passage listing the steps of respiration (P06) therefore has from_heading "unsure". P02 is a short, self-contained biography of the anatomist Alfonso Corti and his work on the mammalian auditory system - it does not belong to any respiratory heading in this chapter, so it was given its own named subtopic (13) rather than folded into a neighbouring one; P01 (an empty figure immediately preceding it) was read as the accompanying portrait, which is an inference since figure passages carry no text. Respiratory volumes and pulmonary capacities were split into two subtopics because NEET asks about each set separately. Occupational respiratory disorders (P31) was kept separate from asthma/emphysema for the same reason. Chapter-wide SUMMARY passages (P32-P37) and the EXERCISES passage (P38) were distributed to the subtopic whose content each one restates.
